messages:
dana (design): dropped a new micro-proposal: a 'mini-role chooser' inside the members header. It's a condensed dropdown with common presets (Viewer, Editor, Admin) and an 'Advanced' link that opens the full roles matrix. mock: https://figma.com/file/mini-role-chooser
ryan (pm): Sounds promising for one-off adds. We need to be careful about discoverability vs clutter. How does this play with onboarding tours?
dana (design): we'll show it only after the first admin completes onboarding, and add a tiny help tooltip that says 'Quick set role for single invites'. Tooltip copy drafts in figma.
omar (frontend): implementation note: dropdown sets a query param like /invite?preset=editor then opens drawer. Keyboard: enter/space to open, arrows to navigate, esc to close. Will ensure focus moves to email input on open.
lucy (a11y): accessibility notes: treat dropdown as combobox with aria-expanded + aria-controls and label 'Quick role selector'. Ensure selected state has 4.5:1 contrast. Tooltips must be reachable via keyboard and use role="tooltip" with aria-describedby.
dana (design): also proposing an inline SSO banner in the drawer header when org enforces SSO: lock icon + 'SSO required for sign-in' with a link 'See how this affects invites'. Non-blocking, but visible.
omar (frontend): agree. I'll make the banner a status region so screen readers announce it when drawer opens. If enforcement changes dynamically, we'll use alert role.
ryan (pm): product question: should we block invites to external domains when SSO is required? For now, soft-validate and show a warning: 'Emails outside your org domain may be required to sign in via SSO.'
dana (design): copy variants: 'Add someone' vs 'Invite a teammate' for header A/B. Also short microcopy under the selector: 'Quick set role for single invites.'
lucy (a11y): one more: any dynamic warning should be announced with role="alert" and keyboard focus shouldn't be stolen. Provide a 'More info' button that expands details with aria-expanded toggles.
audit-bot: audit-preview: https://staging.redwood.tools/mini-roles/2350 build#5090 - includes combobox + banner
omar (frontend): tested staging. Found two issues: 1) combobox labels read twice in VoiceOver. 2) audit prefilter link opens but no focus landing on results. Will fix.
dana (design): for the audit access path, proposal: small 'Recent role edits' link in header that opens /settings/audit?kind=role_change&range=14d. Hover reveals a 'quickpeek' card with last 3 anonymized events.
ryan (pm): permission guard: if user lacks audit access, clicking link should show inline CTA 'Request audit access' not a 403. Don't let non-admins land on the raw audit page.
lucy (a11y): quickpeek card must be keyboard accessible and read as a list. Masked entries should have a 'Show details' control for authorized users that toggles aria-hidden.
omar (frontend): timeline: aiming for a QA branch by end of week. Priorities: combobox keyboard flow, banner live region, audit link gating, and contrast fixes.
dana (design): I'll add the copy variants and the quickpeek visuals to figma. small A/B plan: selector present vs absent, header copy variants.
ryan (pm): good. Lucy, can you run a quick screen reader pass when Omar flags the branch?
lucy (a11y): yes - I'll do NVDA + VoiceOver checks and post a short checklist back here.
dana (design): thanks everyone. post the preview link and any follow-ups in this thread. :seedling:
